integrity: Analytic proof plus a standard-library exact-rational supplementary checker; historical priority not independently verified.
scientific_limitations: Real one-dimensional finite paths with clamped endpoints; exact if-and-only-if for n>=6 and rapidly decaying continuous range affinities. No claim on two-input Lipschitz constants, wider windows, or slow-tail converse. The earliest day-verifiable electronic record associated with the original bilateral filtering source is its IEEE Xplore addition on 2002-08-06, not its first historical appearance at ICCV 1998.
title: A sharp product threshold for total-variation stability of directed three-point bilateral filters
